# MiniGT rare models price tracker

> Retail and resale prices in Hong Kong dollars (HKD) for 13 rare Mini GT 1:64 diecast models, matched on exact catalogue numbers. Last updated 2026-10-08.

Retail = average listed price for a new car (sold-out listings included and flagged). "Close match" = same car under another catalogue code because no shop lists the exact code. Resale = secondary-market range, usually eBay asking prices. Sources are linked on each model page.
